meta.note: X highlights on x.com require JS and are currently un-scrapeable (Nitter/XCancel both shut down 24 Aug 2026 after X Corp cease & desist). Data therefore reconstructed from linked GitHub repositories, live Vercel deployments and README content. All repos below were actively pinned / referenced in highlights.

projects.title: 3D Chess Game
projects.headline: Fully interactive 3D chess with Three.js, GLTF models and complete chess rules
projects.description: A complete 3D chess game built with Three.js, TypeScript and Vite. Features an 8x8 board with alternating squares, GLTF 3D models for all 6 piece types, legal-move highlighting, capture detection, turn alternation with smooth camera transitions, captured-piece counters and a pre-game setup for player names/color choice. Architecture split into ChessGame, ChessBoard, ChessPiece, TurnManager and UIManager classes.
features: 8x8 board with highlights for possible moves
Full chess rules (pawn, rook, knight, bishop, queen, king)
projects.localRun: npm install && npm run dev → http://localhost:5173
projects.highlightReason: Most starred 3D/WebGL demo on profile — showcases React Three Fiber / shader foundation mentioned in CV summary

projects.title: Zitics Pvt Ltd — Company Website
projects.headline: WordPress marketing site with SVG line animations and micro-interactions
projects.description: End-to-end company website for Zitics Pvt Ltd built on WordPress with a custom theme. Features SVG line-draw animations in the hero, orchestrated micro-interactions across sections, custom contact & career flows, and a performant, SEO-optimized WordPress delivery focused on lead generation.
projects.highlightReason: Company marketing site delivered end-to-end — WordPress + SVG motion + micro-interactions

projects.title: Tuscani Villa Estate — Real Estate Landing Page
projects.headline: Luxury villa showcase with cinematic video hero, gallery lightbox and Three.js canvas
projects.description: Next.js 15 (Turbopack) luxury landing page for Villa Europa. Crafted as a conversion-focused estate showcase: full-screen video hero with staged loading sequence, parallax scroll progress, gallery with zoom/pan lightbox, detail tabs (overview, amenities, location), and a Three.js CanvasElement for immersive visuals. Deployed on Vercel as tuscani-villa-estate.vercel.app. Frequently highlighted on X as 'Tuscani Villa project'.
features: Image gallery with lightbox, zoom 0.5-3x and drag pan
Tabs for property specs, amenities, map
projects.highlightReason: Flagship real-estate demo requested by user — polished production deployment

projects.title: Nobel Portfolio Redesign
projects.headline: Dark-mode portfolio redesign with Framer Motion and React Three Fiber
projects.description: Vite + React 19 portfolio rebuild (black theme) deconstructed into Navbar, Hero, About, Projects, CTA and Contact sections. Uses Framer Motion for entrance/scroll reveals, @react-three/fiber + drei for 3D accents, Radix Select/Dialog for interactions, and Tailwind 4. Serves as the 'portfolio redesign project' referenced in highlights — modern, editorial, high-contrast aesthetic.

projects.title: 3D Restaurant Menus — 3D Hotel Menu
projects.headline: Interactive 3D menu experience with Supabase, Prisma and QR scanning
projects.description: Next.js 15 hospitality app (named 3d-hotel-menu in package.json) that renders restaurant menus as explorable 3D scenes. Scan QR at table → AR-ready 3D dish models via @react-three/fiber + drei + @react-three/xr. Backend: Prisma + Supabase + @prisma/client, auth/storage via supabase-js. Extra utilities: react-qr-code, react-zxing, swiper for dish carousels, sonner toasts, next-themes.
projects.highlightReason: Most innovative 3D commerce example — blends hospitality + WebXR

projects.title: Immersive 3D Real Estate Portfolio
projects.headline: Fiverr portfolio piece: HDR-lit virtual tours with Three.js
projects.description: Vite + React 19 portfolio built to sell Fiverr gigs for 3D real-estate tours. Users navigate a full 3D property with HDR environment mapping for realistic lighting. Features: immersive first-person navigation, HDR-based illumination, responsive mobile/desktop, react-router sections. Uses @react-spring/three for smooth transitions and @react-three/a11y for accessibility.
projects.highlightReason: Complementary to Tuscani Villa — shows progression in 3D real-estate work

projects.title: IronForge Personal Training
projects.headline: Gym landing built with AI Studio + Framer Motion
projects.description: Marketing site for a personal training brand, bootstrapped from Google AI Studio (drive/1Zn3ZP73...). Clean Vite + React 19 build with Framer Motion for scroll reveals and parallax. GEMINI_API_KEY via .env.local hints at planned AI workout generation. Banner asset 1200×475.
projects.highlightReason: Latest 2025 fitness vertical — shows variety beyond real-estate/3D

projects.title: 21 Global Replica (TanStack Start)
projects.headline: Pixel-perfect replica built with TanStack Start, Lenis smooth scroll and shadcn
projects.description: Full marketing site replica using the newest TanStack Start (SSR + nitro) stack.
